identification: Phillips & Son, Devonport (Tasmania) cream glazed stoneware ginger beer bottle, black transfer roundel 'This bottle is the property of Phillips & Son, Ginger Beer, Devonport', internal screw thread neck, c. early 20th century. Photos show no chips or cracks, light grime. Common-ish Tasmanian bottle; the firm's soda syphons are better known.
